name: draw_string_glyphs_at_offset
description: Measures a string to position it from a column offset, then walks its bytes, skipping spaces and characters without a glyph entry, and blits each glyph from the font table into the display planes. Setup and teardown calls frame the drawing loop.

name: draw_centered_wrapped_text_box
description: Measures a message string and sizes a box to fit it, capped at 300 pixels wide, then centers the box horizontally. The text is word-wrapped and spread across lines with extra spacing, each glyph is blitted from the font table, and closing border lines are drawn last.

name: draw_pipe_separated_text_panel
description: Splits a message on pipe characters, finds the widest segment to size a centered panel, and clears the panel area before drawing its border. Each line is then rendered glyph by glyph from the font table, with the vertical start chosen by a small mode argument.

name: draw_row_menu_with_selection
description: Draws a framed panel of fixed-width text rows, twenty bytes apart, into the display planes, with the layout clamped to the screen edges. It then polls an input routine and redraws the panel with a selected row across four planes.

name: draw_text_rows_with_highlight
description: Draws a framed block of fixed-width text rows into the display planes, clamping the block to the bottom of the screen. When a highlight row index is passed, it redraws that row across all four planes.

name: build_marked_string_index
description: Clears a twenty-entry string buffer, then scans the 255-record table and copies each record whose flag is set and whose marker is -2 into the next free slot. It stores each copied record's index in a parallel array and returns the number copied.

name: find_indexed_entry_for_key
description: Searches the marked string buffer for a key and returns the record index stored for the match. It returns -2 when the buffer is empty and -1 when no key matches.

name: read_string_menu_choice
description: Returns -2 when the string list is empty. Otherwise it presents the list to a menu routine, waits for a nonzero input word and then for that word to clear, and returns the last value read.

name: clamp_packed_nibble_adjustments
description: Doubles the fields of both arguments, then adjusts three nibble values taken from the first argument by the second argument's fields. Each value is clamped to the range zero to fifteen and the three are packed into one word.

name: adjust_word_table_rows
description: Runs sixteen passes over a sixteen-word table, adjusting each word with the nibble clamping routine and copying each finished row out, with display timing waits between passes. Two final calls take their values from the global state.

name: process_word_table_reverse
description: Runs sixteen passes in descending order over a sixteen-word table, combining each word with a shrinking argument through the nibble clamping routine. Each finished row is copied out, and two closing calls take values from the global state.

name: fill_word_table_range
description: Fills each entry of the word table from a start index through an end index with the result of the nibble clamping routine, using the same two argument values for every entry.

name: rotate_word_table_segment
description: Rotates a segment of the word table by one position, to the right when the mode argument is one and to the left when it is two. For any other mode it copies the segment from the source row, and the table is then copied out.

name: insert_word_at_range_start
description: Shifts the later entries of a word range up by one slot, then stores a saved word at the start of the range. The table is then copied out.

name: rotate_or_copy_word_segment
description: Rotates a word segment left by one position when the mode argument is two, moving the first entry to the end of the range. For any other mode it copies the segment from the source row, and the table is then copied out.

name: shift_word_range_and_append
description: Shifts entries of the word table one slot toward the start of the range, then stores a saved word in the last slot of the range. The table is then copied out.

name: copy_word_range_from_source
description: Copies a range of entries from the source word row into the working word table over the given indices, then copies the table out.

name: copy_word_table_range
description: Copies words from the source row into the working word table from a start index through an end bound, then copies the table out.

name: open_database_and_load_records
description: Resets the 255-entry record table and its counters, closes any file already open, then opens the database file and reads its two header words and record block into the table. If the file cannot be opened it shows the 'Couldn't open DATABASE' error text instead.

name: clear_records_and_close_file
description: Clears the fields of all 255 records in the table, then closes the open file if its handle is positive and marks the handle as unused.

name: split_words_into_four_planes
description: Distributes a stream of four-word groups across four separate destination arrays, storing the first, second, third and fourth word of each group in a different array. All four destination pointers advance together with each group.

name: find_record_index_for_name
description: Returns -1 when no file is open. Otherwise it reads a name from the open file into a buffer, then searches the 255 record entries for an equal name and returns the matching index, or -1 when none matches.

name: seek_and_read_record_block
description: Seeks the open file to the offset stored in a record and reads the record's data block into the destination with the size stored in that record.

name: copy_bytes_and_advance_source
description: Copies a given number of bytes from a source cursor into a destination buffer, then stores the advanced cursor back, so the next call continues where this one stopped.

name: load_image_frames_for_record
description: Looks up a named record, reads a twenty-two-byte header and allocates a frame buffer for each frame, recording the record index and frame number for each one. If an allocation fails it reports the failure with the frame and size values.

name: expand_nibble_mask
description: Returns zero for a zero input. Otherwise it transforms each of the three low nibbles by doubling it and setting its low bit, then repacks them into one word.

name: load_picture_and_palette
description: Looks up a file record and reads its small header, then reads a thirty-two-byte block into the sixteen-word palette table. Picture data is read into the display buffers in the same call, with the two buffers swapped first when the current one matches.

name: load_picture_by_name_extension
description: Looks up a file record, copies its name, reads the header from the open file and checks the name's extension. An extension of N reads the thirty-two-byte block after a four-byte offset, while other extensions read a two-byte field first; the routine returns 1 when an extension is present and 0 otherwise.

name: load_named_picture_frame
description: Performs the same extension-dependent reads as the previous routine on a name held in the caller's frame, and stores the next read offset in a global field. It returns 1 when the name has an extension and 0 otherwise.

name: read_picture_block_by_extension
description: Reads the next picture block from the open file using the name held in the caller's frame, following the same extension-dependent reads. It returns 1 when the name has an extension and 0 otherwise.

name: select_picture_read_by_extension
description: Checks whether the name held in the caller's frame has an extension, and if so reads the picture block with an offset chosen by that extension. It stores the next read offset in a global field and returns 1, or 0 when there is no extension.

name: read_header_and_palette_block
description: Reads a two-byte field and then a thirty-two-byte block from the open file into the caller's buffers, advances the stored read offset, and returns 1.

name: stub_return_zero
description: Returns zero immediately, with no reads, writes or calls.

name: read_dimensioned_bitmap_from_file
description: Opens the named file, reads two word dimensions from it, then reads width times height bytes into the destination buffer before releasing the file handle.

name: unpack_backward_packed_stream
description: Decodes a packed stream that fills its output buffer from the end toward the start, using a bit reader that keeps a running checksum. Each step either copies a run of earlier output or emits a bit-decoded literal, until the buffer is full.

name: shift_bits_across_words
description: Shifts a 32-bit register right by the given number of bits, reloading it from the previous longword with its top bit set whenever it runs out.

name: load_slot_table_from_source
description: Frees the buffers held in a fifty-entry slot table, then reads the slot count and each slot's offset and size from the file. If the file cannot be opened, it looks up the record in the open database and loads the same slot data from there.

name: load_sparse_slot_entries
description: Looks up a database record and reads its slot list, loading each entry in turn. Entries marked with the sentinel value -2 are skipped by advancing the read position instead of reading data.

name: reload_record_slot_table
description: Frees the buffers in a table of 255 twelve-byte slots, then looks up a record and reads its slot descriptors, four words each. It allocates a buffer for each descriptor whose first word is nonzero and stores the returned handle back into the table.

name: reload_six_byte_slot_table
description: Clears the slot count and frees the buffers in a 255-entry table of six-byte slots, then looks up a record and reads its slot count and descriptors. It allocates a buffer for each nonzero descriptor and stores the returned handle in the table.

name: draw_nonempty_string_slots
description: Checks four twenty-byte string slots and, for each one that is not empty, calls a set of routines that draw the slot's text at a position tied to its slot number.

name: reset_all_loaded_state_tables
description: Releases any buffers still held by the slot and record tables, then zeroes those tables, the 255 string entries, the word arrays and several counters. It finishes by initialising the default named entries, including the default data file name, and running a few setup routines.

name: load_directory_index_or_defaults
description: Builds the path of a fixed index file and opens it. When the file opens, it reads a 200-byte index into the table and returns 1; otherwise it fills ten twenty-byte entries with a default string and returns 0.

name: read_directory_index_block
description: Reads a 200-byte block from the open index file into the table, releases the file handle, and returns 1.

name: load_state_from_backup
description: Opens the named backup file and clears the loaded game state tables. If the file cannot be opened it reports that the backup does not exist and returns minus one; otherwise it reads the saved tables, counters and word arrays back from the file in sequence.

name: restore_state_from_open_file
description: Clears the same game state tables as the backup loader, then reads the saved fields and counters from the open file in sequence.

name: read_save_entries_restore_slots
description: Reads a counted run of fixed-size save entries from the open file, then for each named slot that is set it reloads that slot's data. It returns zero.

name: read_save_entries_restore_named
description: Reads a counted run of save entries from the open file, then for each named slot that is set it reloads that slot's data. It returns zero.

name: read_save_entries_restore_stream
description: Reads a counted run of save entries from the open file with a two-word length prefix, then reloads each set named slot. It returns zero.

name: read_save_restore_named_slots
description: Reads a single counted list of save entries from the open file, then reloads each named slot that is set. It returns zero.

name: append_record_node_to_list
description: Walks the linked list of loaded records to its tail and allocates a new 214-byte node, linking it in. It then reads two 100-byte fields and three word fields from the input, and stores the buffer pointer of the slot named by the index it read.

name: append_record_node_from_stream
description: Allocates a 214-byte node at the tail of the record list and reads its two 100-byte fields and three word fields from the input. It then stores the buffer pointer of the slot named by the index read.

name: append_record_node_from_source
description: Allocates a 214-byte node at the tail of the record list, reads its two 100-byte fields and three word fields from the input, and stores the buffer pointer of the slot named by its index.

name: read_and_link_record_node
description: Allocates a 214-byte node and links it into the chain headed by the caller's pointer. It then reads two 100-byte fields and three word fields into the node and stores the buffer pointer of the slot named by the index read.

name: refresh_record_slot_pointers
description: Walks the linked record list and, for each node, stores the buffer pointer of the slot named by the node's index field.

name: append_record_to_secondary_list
description: Appends a new 214-byte node to the secondary record list and reads its fields from the input. It then stores the buffer pointer from the twelve-byte table entry named by its index.

name: link_secondary_record_node
description: Allocates a 214-byte node, links it into the secondary chain, and reads its two 100-byte fields and three word fields. It then stores the buffer pointer from the twelve-byte table entry named by the index read.

name: refresh_secondary_slot_pointers
description: Walks the secondary record list and, for each node, stores the buffer pointer from the twelve-byte table entry named by the node's index field.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Returns immediately without doing any work.

name: append_twenty_byte_entry
description: Allocates a twenty-byte node, fills it with twenty bytes from the input, and appends it to one list at its tail. It is also pushed onto the head of a second list.

name: read_twenty_bytes_into_list
description: Allocates a twenty-byte node, reads twenty bytes from the input into it, and links it into the list named by the caller. When no list is given it uses the default list head.

name: append_entry_to_pair
description: Allocates a twenty-byte node at the tail of one list, fills it with twenty bytes from the input, and pushes it onto the head of a second list.

name: read_bytes_into_second_list
description: Allocates a twenty-byte node, reads twenty bytes from the input into it, and links it into the second list, using that list's default head when none is given.

name: draw_active_object_entries
description: Walks the active entries of a table with 26-byte records, reading or releasing each entry's data block and drawing it into the back display buffer with blitter calls. The display buffers are swapped first when the current one is in use, and the work buffer is released at the end.

name: draw_pending_entries_from_index
description: Restarts the table walk from a given index and draws each entry that shares the current handle by reading its data block into the back display buffer. It ends when the table is exhausted and releases the work buffer.

name: draw_matching_entry_run
description: Draws a run of consecutive table entries that share the current handle, reading each block and blitting it into the back buffer. It then moves on to the next entry whose handle differs.

name: draw_entries_grouped_by_handle
description: Draws the entries that share the handle at the current index, blitting each data block and advancing through the table until the handle changes or the table ends.

name: draw_entries_grouped_by_index
description: Draws the entries that share the handle at a given index, reading each data block and advancing until the handle changes or the table ends. It then releases the work buffer.

name: draw_next_handle_group
description: Scans the table for the next entry with an active handle and draws it together with the following entries that share its handle. It returns once the table is exhausted.

name: draw_queued_entry_list
description: Walks a linked list of queued entries and blits each one's data block using the handle from its table entry and the coordinates stored in the node. Entries with a zero flag get a plain blit, while the others get a variant with extra blitter parameters.

name: blit_linked_entries_by_table
description: Walks a linked list of entries and, for each one, blits its data block using the handle and size from its table entry together with the coordinates stored in the node. The walk continues until the list ends.

name: blit_linked_entries_with_flags
description: Walks a linked list of entries and blits each one's data block from its table entry. A nonzero flag in the node selects a variant with extra blitter parameters, and the walk ends when the list does.

name: stub_no_operation_return
description: Returns immediately without doing any work.

name: prompt_insert_disk_for_volume
description: Builds a prompt that asks the player to insert a named disk, using the volume name from a global table, and draws it in a dialog box. It then polls input until the response is received.

name: loop_until_flag_then_forever
description: Polls a routine until a flag word clears, then calls two routines in an endless loop so the program never returns from this point.

name: setup_blitter_and_wait
description: Waits for the display raster position, sets up the blitter with the display buffer pointers and their offsets, and starts one full-height blit.

name: draw_wide_pipe_text_panel
description: Measures a pipe-separated message and sizes a centered panel at least 180 pixels wide, then draws its frame. Each line is wrapped and drawn glyph by glyph from the font table into the display planes.

name: draw_wrapped_text_panel_lines
description: Sizes and centers a text panel from the widest line of its message, then draws each word-wrapped line glyph by glyph into the display planes.

name: resume_text_panel_drawing
description: Resumes drawing a text panel from its measured width, sizing and centering it at least 180 pixels wide. It then draws the remaining wrapped lines glyph by glyph and closes the border lines.

name: draw_text_panel_for_row
description: Draws a text panel whose width and vertical position come from a row index, sizing it at least 180 pixels wide and centering it. It renders each wrapped line glyph by glyph into the display planes and then closes the border lines.

name: draw_prompt_text_panel
description: Sizes and draws a text panel for a prompt, then loops drawing its wrapped text lines and the entry cursor until the entry is finished.

name: draw_text_entry_panel_lines
description: Draws the wrapped lines of a text entry panel, then closes the border and draws the prompt line with the typed text. It then waits for keyboard input.

name: read_text_entry_keystrokes
description: Reads keys for a text entry field: printable characters are appended up to the field's length, backspace removes the last character, and carriage return or escape ends the entry. The field is redrawn after each key.

name: redraw_text_entry_field
description: Redraws a text entry field with its typed text and cursor, positioning each character glyph from the font table.

name: read_text_entry_input_loop
description: Waits for keyboard input for a text entry field, appending printable characters up to nineteen entries and handling backspace. The cursor blinks by toggling every sixteen frames, and the loop returns once enter or escape is pressed.

name: read_keys_until_enter
description: Reads keys into a text entry field until enter or escape is pressed, drawing each typed character and removing one on backspace.

name: read_keys_with_cursor
description: Reads keys into a text entry field and redraws the field after each key, keeping the cursor drawn at the end of the typed text.

name: call_two_routines_then_return
description: Calls two routines in sequence and returns.

name: update_sprite_offsets
description: When the selected record differs from the current one, adjusts two stored offsets by the change in the record's position. It then copies the record's paired data into the working buffer, clears the buffer's trailing pair and records the new selection.

name: initialize_display_structure
description: Copies two position values into the stored offsets, writes two constant header words into the display structure, and fills sixteen pairs of words from the table. It then clears the trailing pair and resets the selection index.

name: install_interrupt_handler_state
description: Saves the frame pointer and the previous global value, stores a new handler address, and writes the interrupt enable register with the master enable bit set. The routine returns the caller's register pair unchanged.

name: restore_interrupts_and_disable_dma
description: Restores a saved global value and writes the interrupt enable register with the master enable bit set. It then writes the DMA control register with the enable bit clear, which disables the four audio DMA channels.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: The decompiled bytes are not a valid routine. It only updates one byte in memory and then hits bad instruction data, so no real behaviour is recovered.

name: stub_bad_instruction_on_check
description: Checks a bit in the global status word and calls a routine when it is set, then hits bad instruction data. The decoded bytes are not a valid routine, so no real behaviour is recovered.

name: update_mouse_position
description: Reads the mouse counter register and converts the change since the last read into signed deltas, which it adds to the stored pointer position. It clamps the position to the screen area, writes the pointer sprite control words, and then loads the copper list pointer.

name: setup_blitter_line_between_points
description: Sets up the blitter in line mode between two points by computing the octant from their coordinate differences and writing the line's addresses, modulo and error terms. It then waits until the blitter is idle.

name: copy_length_prefixed_string
description: Copies a length-prefixed string from the source into the destination byte by byte, then terminates the destination with a zero byte.

name: search_string_table
description: Walks a linked list of entries, copying each unflagged candidate name and comparing it with the input. It sets a result flag when the comparison returns zero, and returns that flag with the list pointer.

name: find_trackdisk_unit_status
description: Uses the system library to locate the trackdisk device, then reads the status byte and an enable bit from the requested unit's entry. It returns minus one when that unit is absent.

name: call_device_if_present
description: Calls a routine to look up a device handle and returns minus one when none is found. Otherwise it passes the handle to a second routine and returns zero.

name: wait_for_disk_insert_prompt
description: Skips the wait when the drive check reports ready. Otherwise it polls the drive status bits and shows the insert-disk message every hundred polls until a disk is detected.

name: poll_drive_until_disk_inserted
description: Polls a drive status word until a disk is detected, showing the insert-disk message every hundred polls. It clears the prompt state once the disk is present.

name: prompt_for_formatted_diskette
description: Shows the message asking for a formatted diskette and polls the drive status, repeating the message every hundred polls, until a disk is present.

name: wait_for_drive_status_idle
description: Waits for three drive status conditions to clear in turn and returns the final status word.

name: wait_for_drive_ready_status
description: Waits in three passes until the drive status bits clear, then returns the last status value read.

name: wait_for_drive_status_retry
description: Checks the drive status bits repeatedly and waits again while they are set, then finishes the three-stage wait and returns the last value read.

name: finish_drive_status_wait
description: Completes a drive status wait by reading the status until its bits are clear, then returns the last value read.

name: read_drive_status_bits
description: Reads drive status words in a loop and returns the high half of the word once no status bits are set.

name: manage_dos_library_resources
description: Tidies up earlier DOS and audio state, waits for a lock flag to clear, then looks up and opens the DOS library through the system library. It closes the library again when a shutdown is pending.

name: examine_and_lock_file
description: Locks a named file, examines it into a freshly allocated info block, and reads one field from that block. It then unlocks the file and frees the block.

name: set_global_flag_to_one
description: Sets a global flag word to one and returns.

name: wait_until_flag_reaches_target
description: Sets a global flag to one when it is zero, then busy-waits until the flag reaches a fixed target value.

name: initialize_cia_resource
description: Opens the ciaa.resource through the system library when the setup flag is set, fills fifteen global words from a configuration block, and marks the CIA state as initialised.

name: shutdown_audio
description: When the audio-ready flag is set, it calls the audio library to shut down, resets the audio DMA channels, and then clears the flag.

name: free_memory_block_if_allocated
description: When the audio-ready flag and a stored block pointer are both set, frees that memory block through the system library and clears the ready flag.

name: compute_max_table_entry_scaled
description: Scans a table of bytes whose length comes from a global count, keeps the largest value found, and returns that maximum plus one multiplied by 1024.

name: write_cia_timer_registers
description: Writes a fixed value to a CIA control register, then copies a stored value into a timer register.

name: clear_pointer_table_entries
description: Writes zero to the location pointed to by each of fifteen entries in a global pointer table.

name: reset_audio_volume_registers
description: Writes zero to the four audio volume registers and one custom register, sets one state word to all ones, and clears several global audio state variables.

name: initialize_audio_dma_channels
description: Clears the four audio volume registers and state words, sets each channel's length to one word, and points all four channel pointers at the same global buffer. It finishes by writing the channel mask to the DMA control register.

name: call_routine_and_return_zero
description: Calls one routine and returns zero.

name: tick_audio_channels_six_step
description: Advances a six-step tick counter. On each of the first five ticks it updates all four audio channel register blocks, and on the sixth tick it resets the counter and advances the playback position, capping the position at its limit.

name: call_routine_and_return_argument
description: Calls one routine and returns the eight-byte value that was passed to it on the stack.

name: write_audio_channel_pointers
description: Calls a routine for each of the four audio channels with the channel index and its register block address, then returns the value passed in.

name: process_audio_channel_effect
description: Handles one step of an audio channel's tracker effect. When the note value is zero it advances the channel's slide state; otherwise it reads an effect nibble and applies a volume slide, period slide or flag change to the channel's period and volume words.

name: slide_channel_period_with_limit
description: Adds the step amount to the channel's stored value and clamps the result to a limit, then stores it as the new value.

name: apply_audio_channel_effect
description: Applies one tracker effect to an audio channel from its effect nibble, updating the channel's volume or period and setting or clearing its playback flag.

name: set_cia_port_status_bit
description: Sets bit one of CIA-A port A, which carries joystick fire and disk status bits, by updating its image.

name: clear_cia_port_status_bit
description: Clears bit one of CIA-A port A, which carries joystick fire and disk status bits, by updating its image.

name: lookup_channel_period_from_note
description: Stores a note value and its effect offset in a channel record, then searches a note table for the value. A match stores the table period adjusted by the offset, and no match stores the raw note value.

name: copy_word_with_signed_offset
description: Copies a word from a source table, offset by a signed multiple of the index, into a channel field. The sign is chosen by a flag held in another register.

name: store_word_in_channel_field
description: Stores the word passed in the data register into a channel record field.

name: lookup_note_period_for_effect
description: Stores a note value and an effect offset in a channel record, then searches the note table for the value. A match stores the table period shifted by the offset, and no match stores the raw note value.

name: dispatch_audio_effect_handler
description: Calls one audio effect handler, chosen from a jump table by the six-step tick counter minus one, through an indirect jump.

name: lookup_table_value_by_key
description: Searches a table for the record's key value and stores the entry at the index held in a register into the record's output field.

name: lookup_entry_by_high_nibble
description: Searches a table for the record's key value and stores the entry selected by the high nibble of its effect byte into the output field.

name: lookup_entry_by_low_nibble
description: Searches a table for the record's key value and stores the entry selected by the low nibble of its effect byte into the output field.

name: copy_channel_record_word
description: Copies a stored word from the channel record into the output field unchanged.

name: adjust_word_by_effect_nibbles
description: Adds the high nibble of the effect byte to a stored word when that nibble is nonzero, otherwise subtracts the low nibble, and stores the result in the output field.

name: decrement_short_by_nibble
description: Subtracts the low nibble of the record's fourth byte from the stored short when that nibble is nonzero, and stores the result in the output field.

name: configure_audio_dma
description: Clears the audio status word and steps each of the four channels, then enables the DMA channels by writing the status word with the enable bit set. After a short delay it copies four channel pointer and length pairs into the audio channel registers, and advances a buffer index that wraps at its limit.

name: update_audio_channel_state
description: Updates one audio channel's record from the command word and the channel table entry. A command that is not the stop marker loads the sample pointer, length and volume, applies the volume or period effect, and writes the result to the record.

name: apply_audio_channel_volume_effect
description: Applies a volume step to an audio channel, clamps the result to the range zero to sixty-four, and writes the adjusted volume into the channel record. The channel is cleared when its marker is the stop value.

name: slide_audio_channel_volume_up
description: Adds a step to an audio channel's volume, clamps the result to sixty-four, and writes it into the channel record. It also loads the sample pointer when the channel's marker is set.

name: retrigger_audio_channel_sample
description: When the channel has a pending command, it clears the channel's data pointer, waits briefly, then latches the new sample pointer and length from the record and sets the channel's DMA bit. A stop command clears the channel's volume instead.

name: store_channel_sample_fields
description: Copies the sample pointer, length word and status word from a channel record into the channel's output structure, then ORs the record's DMA bit into the global DMA status word.

name: call_two_routines_undecoded
description: The decompiler timed out on this routine, so its body is not recovered. From the listed facts it has nine instructions, is called through a pointer in the data hunk, and calls two other routines.

name: reset_channel_buffer_and_mask
description: Clears the first word of a channel buffer and the word at its end, then calls a routine twice, first with a mask of sixty-three and then with one and zero.

name: decrement_and_reset_channel_level
description: Subtracts ten from a stored word, clears the first word of a channel buffer and the word at its end, clamps a level word to sixty-three, and calls a routine with the channel's values.

name: call_one_routine_undecoded
description: The decompiler timed out on this routine, so its body is not recovered. From the listed facts it has seven instructions, is called through a pointer in the data hunk, and calls one other routine.

name: clear_sound_buffer_init_twice
description: Clears the first word of a sound buffer and the word at its end, then calls a routine twice, first with a mask of sixty-three and then with one and zero.

name: open_cia_resource_once
description: Opens the ciaa.resource through the system library the first time it is called and sets a flag, so later calls do nothing.

name: release_cia_resource_if_open
description: When the resource-open flag is set, it calls the system library to release the resource, calls a second routine, and clears the flag.

name: write_cia_control_timer
description: Writes a fixed control value to a CIA register, then copies a stored timer value into a second register.

name: clear_audio_pointers_and_counters
description: Clears the volume words of the four audio channels, points each channel's data pointer at a shared global buffer, and zeroes four channel counters.

name: reset_audio_and_enable_dma
description: Clears the four audio channel pointers and length words, points each channel at a shared global buffer, and zeroes four channel counters. It then writes the channel mask to the DMA control register.

name: call_routine_and_pass_through
description: Calls one routine and returns the value passed in the data register unchanged.

name: tick_audio_channel_pointers
description: Counts six ticks per step. On the first five ticks it calls one routine for each of the four audio channels; on the sixth it resets the counter, writes the DMA control word with the enable bit set, waits briefly, and points each channel without data at the shared buffer with a length of one word.

name: reset_audio_channels_and_dma
description: Clears two state words and calls a routine for each of the four channels. It then writes the DMA control word with the enable bit set, waits briefly, and points each channel without data at the shared buffer with a length of one word.

name: initialize_sound_channel_state
description: Computes the record offset from a channel index and writes the channel's initial state into it: a cleared longword, followed by several words taken from the parameters.

name: advance_channel_slide_timer
description: Decrements the channel's slide timer while it is nonzero. When the timer reaches zero it reloads it, adds the slide step to the channel value, clamps the result to the range zero to sixty-three, and stores it.

name: clamp_and_store_channel_slide
description: Reloads the channel's slide timer, adds the slide step to its value, clamps the sum to the range zero to sixty-three, and stores it in the channel and in the output.

name: publish_channel_state_when_active
description: When the channel's stored pointer is set, copies the pointer and word fields into the output structure and clears the pointer when the mode word is zero. It then ORs the channel's bit into the global status word.

name: copy_and_update_scroll_state
description: Copies pairs of packed words into a buffer when the mode argument is zero, then updates the scroll offset and clamps it to the buffer width. It writes the bitplane rows through per-plane masks, using shifted source words and the stored scroll remainder.

name: initialize_dos_window_state
description: Allocates a state record, initialises its fields and writes the four-character marker MANX into it. It then fetches the current directory and the standard input and output handles through the dos wrappers, stores them in the record, and passes the record on in a final call.

name: resolve_named_file_entry
description: Resolves a named file entry for a dos operation. An entry with an active lock is re-created through the dos calls, while an unlocked entry is compared with the requested name, and a match allocates and links a new record. It returns a status word.

name: create_dos_process_for_entry
description: Resolves a named file entry as the previous routine does, but it creates a dos process or duplicates a lock through the library wrappers and stores the result in the entry.

name: stub_empty_decompiled_body
description: The decompiler produced an empty body for this 113-instruction routine, so no behaviour is recovered from the pseudo-code. It is recorded as calling one library routine and two other routines.

name: copy_nul_terminated_string
description: Copies bytes from the source string into the destination until the zero terminator, including the terminator, and returns the original destination pointer.

name: copy_string_to_buffer
description: Copies bytes from the source string into the destination until the zero terminator, including the terminator, and returns the original destination pointer.

name: compute_string_length
description: Walks a zero-terminated string to its terminator and returns the number of bytes before it. It does not modify memory.

name: convert_to_uppercase
description: Converts a lowercase ASCII letter to uppercase by subtracting thirty-two, and returns any other byte unchanged.

name: convert_to_lowercase
description: Converts an uppercase ASCII letter to lowercase by adding thirty-two, and returns any other byte unchanged.

name: compare_two_byte_strings
description: Compares two byte strings up to a fixed length limit. It returns minus one or one at the first differing byte, depending on which byte is smaller, and zero when the strings match.

name: copy_memory_block_overlap_safe
description: Copies a block of bytes from source to destination, copying backwards when the destination lies above the source so that overlapping regions are preserved. Nothing is copied when the two pointers are equal.

name: clear_and_open_dos_library
description: Clears a large global work area, records the current task and exec base, and calls a system routine when a flag is set. It then opens dos.library through the exec library and raises a system alert when that open fails.

name: stub_immediate_return
description: Returns immediately without doing any work.

name: parse_command_words_into_argv
description: Splits a command line into words at spaces, tabs and line breaks, honouring double-quoted words with doubled quotes. Each word is stored as a zero-terminated string, and a pointer array for the words is allocated and ended with a null pointer.

name: append_string_to_buffer
description: Appends a zero-terminated source string to the end of the destination string, including its terminator, up to a fixed length limit.

name: concat_string_into_buffer
description: Appends a zero-terminated source string to the end of the destination string, including its terminator, up to a fixed length limit.

name: append_string_with_length_limit
description: Appends a zero-terminated source string to the end of the destination, stopping at the source terminator or when the length limit runs out. A terminator is written when the copy is cut short.

name: copy_string_and_zero_pad
description: Copies a string into a fixed-size field up to the given count and fills any remaining bytes of the field with zeros.

name: open_window_and_icon_library
description: Opens the icon library by name through the exec library, then opens the WINDOW file. It stores the handle and buffer pointers in the state structure passed in and closes the temporary handles before returning.

name: format_into_buffer_and_terminate
description: Stores the destination pointer in a global, runs the formatting routine over the arguments into that buffer, and then writes a terminating zero byte at the pointer. It returns the formatted result.

name: format_buffer_terminate_word
description: Stores the destination pointer in a global, runs the formatting routine over the arguments into that buffer, and then writes a terminating zero byte at the pointer. It returns the formatted result as a word.

name: write_byte_to_output_buffer
description: Writes the low byte of its argument at the current position of the output buffer, advances the position, and returns that byte.

name: format_string_entry_point
description: Passes a format string and its argument list to the formatting routine, using the output byte writer as the sink.

name: call_and_return_concatenated_undecoded
description: The decompiler timed out on this routine, so its body is not recovered. From the listed facts it has forty-eight instructions, is called by one routine, and calls two other routines.

name: format_output_with_conversions
description: Parses a printf-style format string with flags, width, precision and length modifiers. It emits literal characters and conversions for characters, strings, signed and unsigned decimal, octal and base-sixteen values, passing each byte to the output routine. It returns the number of characters written, or minus one on a failed write.

name: perform_signed_division
description: Divides the first signed input by the second using an unsigned routine, negating the quotient when the operand signs differ. It returns that signed result packed with the second register.

name: pack_call_result_with_input
description: Calls one routine and returns a 64-bit value built from the original data register and the value the call left in the next register.

name: call_one_routine_and_return
description: Calls one routine and returns, with no other work.

name: perform_32bit_division
description: Divides a 32-bit dividend by a 32-bit divisor, using a shift-and-subtract loop when the divisor is larger than 16 bits and native division otherwise. It returns the remainder and quotient packed together.

name: call_routine_passthrough_tail
description: Calls one routine and returns, with no other work.

name: call_three_routines_undecoded
description: The decompiler timed out on this routine, so its body is not recovered. From the listed facts it has twenty-one instructions, is called by two routines, and calls three other routines.

name: stub_no_work_return
description: Returns immediately without doing any work.

name: call_two_routines_15_instructions
description: The decompiler timed out on this routine, so its body is not recovered. From the listed facts it has fifteen instructions, is called by two routines, and calls two other routines.

name: store_byte_and_advance_pointer
description: Stores a byte from the record's field at the current pointer position, advances the pointer, and returns the byte.

name: visit_records_in_fixed_stride
description: Walks a range of records that are twenty-two bytes apart, calling a routine for each record start until the end of the range is reached.

name: release_record_and_reset_fields
description: Returns minus one for a null record. Otherwise, when the record's flag byte is set, it calls release routines chosen by its flag bits, combines their results, and zeroes the record's words and flag byte.
